premises.text: An automated credit-fix process can deliver large, fast credit-score improvements by going beyond information to engineered action
premises.evidence_span: By going beyond information to action, we're able to financially engineer improvement for our users

premises.text: The process yields unique psychographic, behavioral, and historical credit data for segments and personas that commoditized score/editorial players lack
premises.evidence_span: We're getting psychographic, behavioral, and historical credit data that we can then leverage to create financial user segments and personas

premises.text: Monetization refers improved users to financial products, then builds own flexible products for their needs
premises.evidence_span: We'll make money by referring them, by matching them to the right financial products

value.text: Americans stuck behind a credit wall get a passport to credit confidence and financial goals
value.evidence_span: helping users overcome the challenges that keeps them from their financial goals

causal_links.evidence_span: financially engineer improvement for our users
holistic view of our users' motivations, actions, and needs
matching them to the right financial products

notes: Transcript opens mid-pitch. Annie point-gain example and 80k fixes/NPS treated as traction/illustration of the fix process, not separate premises.
